usedFor: Bigin holds your deals, and Google Sheets logs them as rows when “New Deal Is Created” runs “Add Multiple Rows”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Deal Is Created” in Bigin, then “Add Multiple Rows” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: Each new Bigin deal lands in a shared sheet you can sort and total without opening the CRM.

watchOut: “Delete Rows” also exists between these apps, so keep it out of any template that runs on every new deal.
